programmes.d: Neelix faces certain death when an alien race stricken by a devastating plague "harvests" his lungs.
The crew discovers that a nebula is not what it seems, and Paris invites his fellow officers to share a little "R&R" in his holodeck program.

Archer, Trip and T'Pol make first contact with the suspicious and militaristic Andorians while helping to reveal the secrets within the ancient Vulcan monastery of P'Jem, uncovering a major violation of the Andorian/Vulcan Peace Treaty
Archer attempts a little diplomacy with a very unwelcoming Vulcan Captain. Reed and Mayweather are in danger while drilling for samples on an uncharted massive comet.
Discovering their first alien civilization, Archer and the crew unfortunately also find a ship of invasive alien miners who are carelessly causing thousands of innocent deaths upon the planet.

programmes.t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Dramatis Personae
programmes.d: Odo is caught in the middle when an alien influence pits Kira against Sisko in a deadly power struggle.
The Enterprise goes to the center of the galaxy, where they find a race of powerful aliens who once fled Earth.
Kirk returns to the "shore leave" planet, but it's not as peaceful as it was when they last saw it.
The crew encounters Harry Mudd again, who is selling a fake love potion.

Da Enterprise passerer igennem en række komplekse energimønstre, prøver besætningen at opklare de mystiske omstændigheder omkring maskinchefassistent Singhs død, samt løjtnant Worf, dr. Crusher og kaptajnens forandrede personligheder.

Da Wesley bliver dømt til døden for uforvarende at overtræde en fremmed planets skikke, bliver kaptajn Picard tvunget til at vælge mellem at forhandle om Wesleys liv eller overholde Føderationens Primærdirektiv.
Et tankeændrende apparat kontrolleret af en ferengisk kaptajn, der er ude på hævn over Picard efter sønnens død, truer kaptajnen og hele besætningens liv.
The discovery of a wormhole in deep space raises the crew's hopes of finding a shortcut home.
Ephraim, a humble tardigrade, is flying through the mycelial network when an unexpected encounter takes her on a bewildering adventure through space.
When a lightning storm in space scares a young Michael Burnham, her father aims to ease her fears with a mythical story about a brave little girl who faced her own fears head on.

12-year-old classmates Kima and Lil find themselves at odds with each other on a day that will change their lives forever.
An alien leader has the technology that could send the crew 40,000 light years closer to home -- but refuses to share it with them.
